# Third-party code

Vendored, pinned sources, built by our CMake (`third_party/CMakeLists.txt`) on every platform.
Update one library at a time: replace its files, bump the version here, note it in CHANGELOG.md.

| Library | Version | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| doctest (`doctest/`) | 2.4.12 | MIT | unit tests (`doctest.h`; `doctest.cmake` + `doctestAddTests.cmake` = CTest discovery) |
| Dear ImGui (`imgui/`) | 1.92.9b | MIT | debug UI |
| nanobench (`nanobench/`) | 4.3.11 | MIT | microbenchmarks (`benchmarks/`; `nanobench.h` + LICENSE) |
| miniaudio (`miniaudio/`) | 0.11.25 | public domain / MIT-0 | audio device and decoding |
| stb_image, stb_image_write, stb_truetype, stb_vorbis (`stb/`) | 2.30, 1.16, 1.26, 1.22 | public domain / MIT | images, fonts, Ogg Vorbis |
| Tracy (`tracy/`) | 0.14.1 | BSD-3-Clause | profiler client (the `public/` folder + LICENSE); only with `WLW_PROFILE` |
| tinygltf (`tinygltf/`) | 2.9 | MIT | glTF loading |
| nlohmann json (`tinygltf/json.hpp`) | 3.12.0 | MIT | JSON (tinygltf, kit save files) |
| glm (`glm/`) | 1.0.1 | MIT (or the Happy Bunny licence; `copying.txt`) | maths (the `glm/` headers of the release) |
| Swappy (`swappy/`) | 2.3.0-alpha01 (AGDK `gamesdk` main 044fd03, 2025-03-10; the repo is archived) | Apache-2.0 | Android frame pacing: the OpenGL part (`src/common`, `src/opengl`, the AGDK helpers it uses in `src/gamesdk`), its public headers and its two Java classes (`java/`, compiled by each game's Gradle build). Patched: `src/gamesdk/ChoreographerShim.h` (4 unused typedefs that clash with NDK 26+ headers, marked) |
| glad (`glad/`) | generated by glad 0.1.36 | MIT (generated code: public domain / CC0) | OpenGL 3.3 core loader, desktop only |

The only dependency outside this folder is GLFW (desktop only), from vcpkg (`vcpkg.json`).
